prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: hit while turning left in Pasadena, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1175; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant told the same account in every conversation.
- The driver lives with the policyholder and is covered as a household member.
text: I was making a left turn at an intersection in Pasadena, Texas, when a vehicle coming from the opposite direction struck the side of my car. I had already stopped partway into the turn and was waiting for a gap in traffic when the impact happened. My car was pushed sideways and my right shoulder hit the door frame hard enough to leave me in pain and unable to lift my arm comfortably. I was taken to be checked and have been following the treatment advice since. I have described what happened the same way every time I have spoken with the insurer, the police, and the medical staff, and I have nothing to add or change. I am the household member of the policyholder, who lives with me at the same address, and I was driving the vehicle with the family's permission.
